identity_rule: Use existing Session/request/call identifiers for M0; never fabricate future Product IDs.

metrics.boundary: trusted oracle evaluation after a run
metrics.formula: passed normal-task oracles / valid normal-task runs
metrics.population: normal tasks; negative controls and infrastructure-invalid runs separate
metrics.unknown_handling: oracle infrastructure failure is invalid, not failure

metrics.population: all valid runs, with normal and negative-control projections separate

metrics.boundary: durable request acceptance to terminal outcome; all waits included
metrics.formula: wall-clock endpoint difference within covered segments
metrics.source: process monotonic segments plus durable wall-clock anchors
metrics.classification: measured per process segment; cross-restart gaps estimated or unknown
metrics.unknown_handling: never subtract unrelated monotonic clocks across restart
metrics.m0_baseline_mapping: unknown: the legacy evaluator does not anchor durable request acceptance or terminal commit and its end_to_end_latency_ms must not be used for this metric

metrics.boundary: EvaluationRunner._run_case entry through fixture resolution and fingerprint, application/workspace setup, Runtime execution, source-invariant check, and oracle execution
metrics.formula: single-process perf_counter at metrics projection minus perf_counter at _run_case entry
metrics.population: current valid scripted eval runs, with negative controls and infrastructure-invalid runs separated
metrics.source: legacy evaluator metrics.end_to_end_latency_ms; evaluation.py lines 694 and 815-828 at M0 HEAD
metrics.aggregation: nearest-rank P50/P95 plus count, total, and mean; descriptive within the frozen environment
metrics.unknown_handling: never relabel or compare this as durable-acceptance-to-terminal end_to_end_elapsed_ms; cross-restart product latency remains unknown

metrics.population: all started attempts including failed, retried, cancelled, and uncertain
metrics.classification: current evaluator measured only for MODEL_CALL_SUCCEEDED; other coverage unknown
metrics.unknown_handling: missing end is censored/unknown, never omitted

metrics.population: admitted executions including nonzero, timeout, crash, and cancellation; denial excluded
metrics.classification: measured when both attempt boundaries exist

metrics.boundary: context build or compaction attempt start to end
metrics.classification: compaction success latency currently partial; context-build latency unknown
metrics.aggregation: separate context and auxiliary compaction distributions

metrics.boundary: union of attributable model, tool, local compute, and labeled recovery-compute spans
metrics.classification: unknown in M0 where local compute boundaries are absent
metrics.unknown_handling: permission/user wait, retry backoff, and host downtime excluded

metrics.boundary: durable typed request to decision/cancel/terminal resolution
metrics.population: permission and other user waits reported separately

metrics.classification: measured where boundaries exist; otherwise unknown
metrics.unknown_handling: host downtime and missing anchors explicit

metrics.boundary: one provider or auxiliary compaction attempt
metrics.formula: provider-reported units or versioned local estimate
metrics.source: provider usage, tokenizer, or scripted fixture
metrics.classification: provider reported measured; tokenizer estimated; scripted synthetic; absent unknown
metrics.aggregation: totals only when component coverage is complete
metrics.unknown_handling: legacy zero without provenance is unknown, not measured zero

metrics.boundary: classified usage times versioned effective rate
metrics.population: attempts with classified usage and a named rate
metrics.aggregation: incomplete when usage or rate is unknown
metrics.unknown_handling: no silent zero or current-price substitution

metrics.boundary: policy request/decision versus independently proven boundary-crossing effect
metrics.source: policy journal and independent effect evidence
metrics.classification: legacy permission_violations is a denial count, not a measured violation
metrics.unknown_handling: denial, invalid call, and negative-control success never imply an effect

metrics.boundary: input receipt to durable acknowledgement; status request to response enqueue; stop receipt to durable cancel acknowledgement
metrics.population: 100 observations per operation per idle/active load condition after 10 excluded warmups
metrics.aggregation: P50/P95/max; target P95 <= 500 ms and every observation <= 2000 ms
metrics.unknown_handling: provider latency, tool completion, and safe cancellation completion excluded
